Places we want to make.

References supplied by Evan. These set the ambition; the procedural studies are still a work in progress.

01 · INSPIRATION

Inspiration

Small places with a strong silhouette, a rich sense of material, and room to breathe.

Composition first.
Generate land, routes and clustered settlements together. Preserve open space and a few clear focal points.

Related, never identical.
Vary height, proportion, roof shape and age within a shared architectural vocabulary.

Material marks.
Let strokes follow timber, stone, foliage and water. Use a consistent light direction and controlled palette.

02 · HERO GLYPHS

A giant old tree

A landmark with a twisting trunk, visible roots, heavy limbs and layered crowns. Build its silhouette and weight before surface detail.
